title: 2.1.8 Chain Three Branches
description: Write an else if chain with at least three branches. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: practice for 'Several Conditions: else if', book 2.1.4

steps.title: Declare a battery level
steps.instructions: Create a variable called batteryPercent and set it to a number from 0 to 100.

steps.title: Chain at least three branches
steps.instructions: Write an if / else if / else if / else chain that logs a status: below 20 logs 'Low battery', below 50 logs 'Battery ok', below 90 logs 'Battery good', and anything else logs 'Battery full'. Check the highest cutoff first, same as the grade example.
